cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Helpful Culprit
cards.instruction: Hide that the problem is your fault while enthusiastically helping investigate it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm only helping with the office plants, but I'll interview everyone who watered this dead one. Nobody throw the soil away yet.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent lead. I'll test the machine first; we shouldn't accuse anyone before checking what comes out of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You made that coffee yourself. With six sugars.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'll make six-sugar samples for comparison. Put the plant by my desk; I'll decide which drinks it couldn't tolerate before we start naming people.
